assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Neuropathy related to tumor infiltration is often painful

assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: Malignant cells, in particular leukemia and lymphoma, can infiltrate cranial and peripheral nerves, leading to mononeuropathy

assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: The neuropathy may improve with treatment of the underlying leukemia or lymphoma

assertions.subject: Mononeuropathy
assertions.quote: The neuropathy may improve with treatment of the underlying leukemia or lymphoma or with glucocorticoids
